hero.title: Circle shares jump as earnings beat offsets revenue miss, Arc blockchain gains Wall Street backing
hero.description: Shares jumped 10% in pre-market trading as the stablecoin issuer revealed institutional adoption for its layer 1 blockchain Arc.

latest.title: Circle shares jump as earnings beat offsets revenue miss, Arc blockchain gains Wall Street backing
latest.description: Shares jumped 10% in pre-market trading as the stablecoin issuer revealed institutional adoption for its layer 1 blockchain Arc.

latest.title: Uber issues weaker-than-expected bookings, earnings forecasts for third quarter
latest.description: Uber's earnings were in line with estimates, but the company's guidance for the third quarter trailed expectations.

latest.title: Novo Nordisk CEO defends economics of Wegovy pill as lower prices weigh on sales; shares fall 5%
latest.description: Wall Street isn't convinced the Ozempic maker has a promising path back to sustainable growth as competition from Eli Lilly intensifies.

latest.title: Bitcoin, broader market fail to keep pace as global equities hit record highs
latest.description: Derivatives data show subdued activity in bitcoin and ether but aggressive positioning in select altcoins.

latest.title: Disney tops earnings estimates as parks and streaming offer a boost
latest.description: Disney reported growth at its domestic theme parks and cruises despite mounting macroeconomic uncertainty for consumers.

latest.title: CVS blows past estimates, hikes guidance as insurance unit continues to improve
latest.description: CVS also announced a new collaboration with Eli Lilly that will make Zepbound and Foundayo accessible to eligible patients on the CVS Health app.

latest.title: Eli Lilly easily tops quarterly estimates, raises outlook as Zepbound and Mounjaro sales surge
latest.description: Eli Lilly now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from a previous guidance of $82 billion and $85 billion.

latest.title: SpaceX dives 12% after AI spending surge rattles investors
latest.description: CEO Elon Musk said SpaceX would hit $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030 versus a previous forecast of 2031 as he looked to strike an bullish tone.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs log inflows as cold wallet hack reignites custody debate
latest.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $382 million in two-day inflows, with Galaxy’s Bitcoin ETF returning to gains as the Coldcard incident renewed custody concerns.

latest.title: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating
latest.description: The rating recognizes the fund’s ability to maintain a stable net asset value, while S&P separately reaffirmed USDT among the lowest-rated stablecoins under its existing assessment framework.

latest.title: AMD plummets 8% in premarket trading despite beating expectations
latest.description: The chip giant has been a big beneficiary of the AI boom, with stock trading 132% up so far in 2026.

latest.title: Anthropic's Mythos created fake identities to fool humans in new cyber incident
latest.description: It's the latest cybersecurity incident involving frontier models developed by Anthropic and OpenAI.

latest.title: Coldcard hack sparks a self-custody security overhaul: Cory Klippsten
latest.description: The attack exposed a five-year-old firmware flaw. The industry’s rapid response is accelerating the adoption of collaborative multisig security.

latest.title: Oil prices move higher after Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis claim Saudi tanker strike
latest.description: Crude prices rose Wednesday after Yemen's Houthis claimed they had struck a Saudi Arabian oil tanker in the Red Sea.

latest.title: Ex-LAPD Officer Gets Life Plus 15 Years Over $350K Bitcoin Robbery
latest.description: Eric Halem and his crew wore police vests to enter a Koreatown high-rise, then handcuffed a 17-year-old and took his hard drive.

latest.title: Trump says Hormuz deal could be agreed Wednesday or Thursday as he  hails ‘very good’ Iran talks
latest.description: U.S. Central Command said the "southern route of the Strait of Hormuz remains free and open"

latest.title: Bitcoin price-metric basket sees longest capitulation since FTX blow-up: Glassnode
latest.description: Glassnode confirmed that its aggregate BTC price cycle tool was in its coldest phase since the collapse of FTX in late 2022.

latest.title: BlackRock brings tokenized money market funds to Europe via JPMorgan
latest.description: JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform will tokenize select BlackRock money market fund shares denominated in pounds, euros and US dollars.

latest.title: Proof of Play to shut down after blockchain gaming thesis falls short
latest.description: The a16z-backed studio will open-source Pirate Nation assets, while an independent foundation continues supporting the PIRATE token.

latest.title: Why bitcoin’s ‘500-day rule’ faces its biggest test yet
latest.description: The so-called ‘500-day rule’ says buying BTC roughly 500 days before a bitcoin halving and selling it about 500 days after would have produced profits in prior cycles.
